verdict.rationale: Solid renders to real DOM elements and is often praised as React-like and easy to pick up (solid-comm-4, solid-comm-14, solid-gh-5), but community feedback also flags real new concepts to learn—signals/reactivity being non-intuitive, props needing to be functions instead of plain values, and unusual naming/API quirks (solid-comm-8, solid-comm-15, solid-comm-16)—contradicting the 'minimal new concepts' claim.
